summary: Describes how to use the Secure Remote Password (SRP) protocol as an authentication method in TLS. SRP lets a user prove knowledge of a password without sending it and without needing certificates. This is an informational memo, not a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: This lets you prove you know a secret password to a website without ever telling the password itself, like showing you know a secret handshake without saying it out loud.

questions: how to use srp with tls
